accepted.s: India occupies which position in the world in milk production?

accepted.s: According to the Indian Year Book 2026, India's per capita milk availability was:

accepted.s: The Gokul Gram cattle-breeding farm of Andhra Pradesh is located at:
accepted.x: The Andhra Pradesh Gokul Gram cattle-breeding farm is located at Chadalawada in Prakasam district.

accepted.s: The Animal Husbandry Infrastructure Development Fund primarily supports the creation of capacity in:
o: Fish-seed production and inland navigation sectors
accepted.x: The fund supports milk-processing and meat-processing capacity.

accepted.s:
Consider the following statements regarding milk production in Andhra Pradesh:
1. Andhra Pradesh ranked seventh in milk production.
2. Its milk output was 139.46 lakh tonnes in the cited 2025–26 assessment.
3. Andhra Pradesh ranked fifth in milk production in the cited 2022–23 assessment.
Which of the statements given above are correct?
accepted.x: All three statements are correct: Andhra Pradesh was seventh with 139.46 lakh tonnes in the current assessment and had ranked fifth in 2022–23.
accepted.tq: Check the year attached to each rank before selecting the coded combination.
accepted.sec: Dairying - India's world rank, Rashtriya Gokul Mission, Gokul Grams in AP  [APPSC, GROUP-II]

accepted.s: Processed food constituted approximately what share of India's agri-food exports in 2024–25?
accepted.x: Processed food accounted for about 23 percent of agri-food exports in 2024–25.
accepted.tq: Distinguish the export share from the similarly shaped percentage options.
accepted.sec: Agro-processing - processed food share, PM Kisan Sampada, mega food parks, PMFME  [APPSC, GROUP-II]

accepted.s: SAMPADA, later implemented as PM Kisan SAMPADA Yojana, stands for:
o: Scheme for Agricultural Markets and Production Development Areas
Scheme for Agriculture, Processing, Marketing and Distribution Assistance
Scheme for Agro-marine Processing and Development of Agro-processing Clusters
Special Assistance Programme for Marine Produce and Dairy Activities
accepted.x: SAMPADA means Scheme for Agro-marine Processing and Development of Agro-processing Clusters.
accepted.tq: Test the exact expansion of an official scheme name, where look-alike expansions are common traps.
accepted.sec: Agro-processing - processed food share, PM Kisan Sampada, mega food parks, PMFME  [APPSC, GROUP-II]

accepted.s: Which one of the following correctly describes PM Kisan SAMPADA Yojana?
o: It was approved in 2017 as a Central Sector scheme and includes an integrated cold-chain component.
It was launched in 2020 as a State Sector scheme and excludes cold-chain infrastructure.
It was approved in 1985 as an export-promotion law administered by APEDA.
It was launched in 2017 exclusively for livestock vaccination.
accepted.x: PM Kisan SAMPADA was approved in 2017 as a Central Sector scheme and includes integrated cold chain among its components.
accepted.tq: Use the authority-year-component combination to reject swapped scheme descriptions.
accepted.sec: Agro-processing - processed food share, PM Kisan Sampada, mega food parks, PMFME  [APPSC, GROUP-II]

accepted.s: PM Kisan SAMPADA Yojana co-finances approximately how many agro-processing and cold-chain units?
accepted.x: The scheme co-finances 1,256 agro-processing and cold-chain units.
accepted.tq: Read the thousands figure carefully and reject digit-shifted numerical distractors.
accepted.sec: Agro-processing - processed food share, PM Kisan Sampada, mega food parks, PMFME  [APPSC, GROUP-II]

accepted.s: PMFME, launched under Aatmanirbhar Bharat, is based on which approach?
accepted.x: The PM Formalisation of Micro Food Processing Enterprises scheme was launched in 2020 under Aatmanirbhar Bharat on a One District One Product basis.
accepted.tq: Discriminate between similar territorial development slogans.
accepted.sec: Agro-processing - processed food share, PM Kisan Sampada, mega food parks, PMFME  [APPSC, GROUP-II]

accepted.s: PMFME was launched in which year?
accepted.x: PMFME was launched in 2020 under Aatmanirbhar Bharat.
accepted.tq: Use chronological separation between PM Kisan SAMPADA and PMFME.
accepted.sec: Agro-processing - processed food share, PM Kisan Sampada, mega food parks, PMFME  [APPSC, GROUP-II]

accepted.s: Which of the following pairs is correctly matched with respect to the location of agro-industries in Andhra Pradesh?
o: Sugar mills — Godavari districts, Visakhapatnam and Chittoor
Sugar mills — only the Rayalaseema districts
Dairy industries — only the Godavari districts
Meat-processing units — exclusively in the coastal districts
accepted.x: Agro-industries tend to locate near raw materials; sugar mills in Andhra Pradesh are associated with the Godavari districts, Visakhapatnam and Chittoor.
accepted.tq: Start from the sure location-resource relationship and reject exclusive claims.
accepted.sec: Agro-processing - processed food share, PM Kisan Sampada, mega food parks, PMFME  [APPSC, GROUP-II]

accepted.s:
With reference to APEDA, consider the following statements:
1. APEDA was established under the APEDA Act, 1985.
2. It promotes processed-food exports.
3. Its BHARATI cohort consisted of 100 start-ups.
4. The cohort exported GI Jardalu mangoes and millet products.
Which of the statements given above are correct?
accepted.x: All four statements are correct. APEDA operates under the 1985 Act, promotes processed-food exports, and its BHARATI cohort of 100 start-ups exported GI Jardalu mangoes and millet products.
accepted.tq: Test the complete institutional profile instead of relying on the name alone.
accepted.sec: Agro-processing - processed food share, PM Kisan Sampada, mega food parks, PMFME  [APPSC, GROUP-II]

accepted.s: Which one of the following is NOT correctly matched regarding Andhra Pradesh's livestock products?
accepted.x: The fourth option is incorrect because 2,739 crore eggs refers to egg production, not meat. Andhra Pradesh ranked fourth in meat production with 11.37 lakh tonnes.
accepted.tq: Find the swapped product-rank-output combination.
accepted.sec: AP livestock products - rankings and top districts  [APPSC, GROUP-II]

accepted.s: The correct descending order of Andhra Pradesh's cited ranks in eggs, meat and milk production is:
accepted.x: Andhra Pradesh ranked first in eggs, fourth in meat and seventh in milk; hence the descending order is eggs, meat and milk.
accepted.tq: Arrange the products by their rank values, not by their output units.
accepted.sec: AP livestock products - rankings and top districts  [APPSC, GROUP-II]

accepted.s: The correct unit for Andhra Pradesh's egg production figure of 2,548.74 in the 2023–24 assessment is:
accepted.x: The correct unit is crore eggs; the printing of lakh eggs is an erroneous unit representation.
accepted.tq: Resolve the unit trap by checking whether the number refers to eggs or tonnes.
accepted.sec: AP livestock products - rankings and top districts  [APPSC, GROUP-II]

accepted.s: Which of the following pairs is correctly matched?
accepted.x: Apiculture is the rearing of bees and yields honey and bee-wax. Sericulture yields silk, pisciculture yields fish and floriculture concerns flowers.

accepted.x: Lac culture produces lac obtained from lac insects.

accepted.s: Which is the correct sequence of stages in the life cycle of honey bees?
accepted.x: Honey bees pass through the stages egg, larva, pupa and adult.
accepted.tq: Use the first and last stages to eliminate reversed biological sequences.

accepted.s: Which of the following statements regarding current agricultural production trends is correct?
o: Horticulture and foodgrains production are both below 200 million tonnes.
Foodgrains production is approximately twice horticultural production.
Horticultural production, at about 362–367 million tonnes, exceeds foodgrains production of 357.73 million tonnes.
Foodgrains production now exceeds horticultural production by a wide margin.
accepted.x: Horticultural output of about 362–367 million tonnes has exceeded foodgrains output of 357.73 million tonnes.
accepted.tq: Compare the two close production ranges rather than relying on the traditional assumption that foodgrains are larger.
accepted.sec: Universal angles

accepted.s:
Consider the following statements:
1. Livestock GVA grew by approximately 195 percent during FY15–FY24.
2. India's seafood was exported to more than 130 countries.
3. Livestock and fisheries both recorded identical growth rates of 8.8 percent over a decade.
Which of the statements given above are correct?
accepted.x: Statements 1 and 2 are correct. Statement 3 is false because livestock growth was about 7.1 percent and fisheries growth about 8.8 percent over the cited decade.
accepted.tq: Spot the false equality in a comparison of two related growth rates.
accepted.sec: Universal angles

accepted.s: Under MIDH, the general funding pattern and the pattern for North-Eastern and Himalayan States are respectively:
accepted.x: MIDH funding follows a 60:40 pattern generally and a 90:10 pattern for North-Eastern and Himalayan States.
accepted.tq: Keep the general and special-region ratios in their correct order.
accepted.sec: Universal angles

accepted.s: Which one of the following pairs is correctly matched with Andhra Pradesh's agricultural and livestock profile?
o: Ongole and Punganur — cattle breeds; Chadalawada — Gokul Gram
Ongole and Punganur — sheep breeds; Chadalawada — mega food park
Ongole and Punganur — fish varieties; Chadalawada — dairy research institute
Ongole and Punganur — poultry breeds; Chadalawada — aquaculture action centre
accepted.x: Ongole and Punganur are important cattle breeds associated with Andhra Pradesh, while Chadalawada is the location of the Gokul Gram.
accepted.tq: Match each place and breed with its correct agricultural category.
accepted.sec: Universal angles

accepted.s: Which of the following statements about Andhra Pradesh's allied-sector position is correct?
o: Andhra Pradesh ranks seventh in eggs and first in milk.
Andhra Pradesh has no leading position in livestock or aquaculture.
Andhra Pradesh ranks first in eggs and aquaculture.
Andhra Pradesh ranks fourth in eggs and seventh in aquaculture.
accepted.x: Andhra Pradesh is ranked first in egg production and aquaculture.
accepted.tq: Use the state-specific superlative and reject reversed product-rank claims.
accepted.sec: Universal angles

accepted.s: The approximate growth rates of livestock and fisheries over the cited decade were respectively:
accepted.x: Livestock grew by about 7.1 percent and fisheries by about 8.8 percent over the cited decade.
accepted.tq: Discriminate between two close sectoral growth rates by preserving their order.
accepted.sec: Universal angles

accepted.s: Which of the following developments is associated with the current fisheries policy context in Andhra Pradesh?
accepted.x: An Andhra Pradesh aquaculture action plan is part of the current fisheries policy context.
accepted.tq: Connect the sector mentioned in the policy development with its specific state action plan.
